clauses.quote: the Chancellor (or her/his designee) and the WTU President (or her/his designee) shall make every effort to provide her/his counterpart with a list of agenda items at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to each meeting.
clauses.subject_text: the Chancellor (or her/his designee) and the WTU President (or her/his designee)
clauses.notes: Joint duty involving both district leadership and union president.

clauses.quote: The Chancellor (or her/his designee) and the WTU President (or her/his designee) shall be permitted to invite Teachers of their respective organizations to the meetings, as necessary.
clauses.subject_text: The Chancellor (or her/his designee) and the WTU President (or her/his designee)
clauses.notes: Joint discretion granted to both parties.

clauses.quote: DCPS and the WTU agree that they shall jointly establish ad hoc working groups, as necessary, to address issues that arise during the standing bi-monthly meetings.
clauses.notes: Operative duty resides in subordinate clause; joint collaboration required.

clauses.quote: The Supervisor shall provide a minimum of sixteen (16) square feet of bulletin board space in the main office for the exclusive use of the WTU.
the WTU shall have a minimum of one-half (1/2) of the space on the existing board(s) in the school office.
the Supervisor shall permit the WTU to install new bulletin boards
shall make WTU-approved accommodations in lieu of additional space.
The Building Representative shall provide the Supervisor with a copy of all materials the WTU plans to display in its dedicated bulletin board space.
All teachers are entitled to have knowledge of promotion policies and procedures.
A copy of promotion policies shall be maintained in the business office in each school
clauses.notes: Extracted before 'and'; passive construction with implicit management agent.

clauses.quote: shall be available for use by teachers.
clauses.notes: Extracted after 'and'; implied subject from prior clause.

clauses.quote: All vacancies to be filled competitively shall be advertised by the school system.
clauses.subject_text: All vacancies to be filled competitively

clauses.quote: The advertisement shall set forth the grade level, application procedures and deadline date for submission of applications.
Additional information concerning positions may be secured from the Office of Human Resources.
Announcements of vacancies shall be posted in a conspicuous place on the business office bulletin board in each school or office by the responsible officer in charge.
Copies shall be sent to the WTU.
applicants shall be given at least fourteen (14) calendar days to submit their applications for the vacancies they are seeking to fill.
clauses.notes: Implicit agent is district management; grants applicants a protected time window.
